The blazer brings a sharp, professional structure that anchors your outfit for an office setting while the bodysuit keeps your silhouette clean and streamlined under it. Your boots handle the frost and keep you warm without slipping, and the tote bag is ready to carry everything you need as you walk to work. The coat wraps over the top layer to shield you from the cold air and snowflakes while maintaining a neat exterior. You chose jeans for comfort on your long walk, but they are styled with enough polish to fit your work day perfectly.\", \"how_to_wear\": [\"Keep the blazer zipped or buttoned at the top to create one clean vertical line from your shoulder down to your waist, which balances the volume of your coat when you open it later.\", \"Tuck the bodysuit in flat against the jacket so there is no bulk showing at the waist as you walk, keeping your focus on a smooth silhouette all day.\", \"Walk with the tote held close to your hip so the length of your boots stays visible and the hem of your coat does not drag or get caught on the ground.\"], \"wrong_photos\": [], \"swap\": {\"item\": null, \"why\": null, \"to\": null}, \"named\": [], \"about_items\": [{\"n\": \"#287·28\", \"text\": \"This blazer provides the necessary professional structure for your work day and creates a crisp line that makes you look put-together even when walking in snow.\"}, {\"n\": \"#50·12\", \"text\": \"The bodysuit keeps your silhouette smooth and streamlined under the blazer, ensuring there is no bulk around the waist as you move through the cold air.\"}, {\"n\": \"#549·37\", \"text\": \"These boots are chosen to handle the frost and snow without open zones, keeping your feet warm and secure while walking to work in any weather.\"}, {\"n\": \"#658·34\", \"text\": \"The tote bag is ready to hold all your work essentials comfortably as you walk, providing a practical yet polished finish to your ensemble.\"}, {\"n\": \"#521·35\", \"text\": \"You chose these jeans for the comfort they offer during your long walk to work, balancing everyday ease with enough polish to meet your professional requirements.\"}, {\"n\": \"#503·04\", \"text\": \"This coat acts as a protective outer layer against the snow and frost, shielding you from the cold while maintaining a neat shape that fits your work occasion.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":3814,"output_tokens":556},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
